name: THE SITTERS
note: THE SÉANCE (doc 111 B, THE LINES: "Five of the town around a table, holding hands, and Madame Ozymandia at the head of it."; errata 238). One cut-out (reference/act3-seance/handback.md, operation 3): the round table under its wine-red cloth to the floor, one candle and one hand bell; Ozymandia at the head, eyes closed, the rod across her palms; a woman in a bonnet, a young man, a grey-haired woman and a bald man; Mr. Frame in the front-left chair with his notebook. Drawn 1:1 (no figureHeight: the sheet was cut at Room 16's man on the floor before the table, 450 px, and its heads match Thad's there), its chairs' feet on the floor at y 812, placed over the plate's own table so the table, the crystal ball, the strong box and the teapot are covered (errata 238). While the séance is on; the lamp turned down (T_SEANCE_DARK) draws the dark sheet, registered on the lit one. Ozymandia's standing figure is not drawn meanwhile (content/ambient/ozymandia.json `when`). Examined through THE SÉANCE TABLE, THE SITTERS, MR. FRAME, AT THE TABLE and MADAME OZYMANDIA, PRESIDING, over their drawn places; TALK TO reaches her through MADAME OZYMANDIA, PRESIDING. Scenery: the pointer passes through it to those hotspots. When the dead have spoken the séance ends (T_SEANCE_ON cleared, after LEAVING THE TABLE's lines) and the group fades: 'Thad stays where he is until the last pair of boots has gone.'
barksNote: Nobody at the table barks: the séance is heard through THE SÉANCE and SEA_E1 (doc 111).
sceneryNote: Errata 238: the five séance subjects are hotspots over the drawn table, lamp, sitters, Frame and Ozymandia; a click on the group is theirs.

sprite.depthYNote: The depth the group's 1:1 scale belongs to: the floor before the table at the walk band's far edge, where Room 16's man is 448, the 450 the cut snapped the sheet at (tools/art/act3-seance-cut.py MAN). Read by the checks only (tests/one-level.test.mjs); the engine draws the sheet 1:1.
sprite.frameNote: 0 rest · 1 a breath (derived: the sitters above the table's far edge lifted a pixel) · 2 the grey-haired woman glancing round at her neighbour · 3 Frame tapping his pencil on his notebook (derived). Every frame is the rest frame with only the head or the hand that moves changed (reference/act3-seance/handback.md).
sprite.membersNote: SIX PEOPLE IN ONE CUT-OUT (errata 238): each sitter's own box in the frame, clear of the cloth where the drawing allows. Errata 77's deliberate action is measured against the person who makes it (tests/movement.test.mjs): a glance is a third of the grey-haired woman, and a fortieth of the whole table.

spriteWhen.note: Doc 111, OZY_E1 option 2: she turns the lamp down to a bead. The same group in near-darkness, the candle the only light, on the lit sheet's canvas and registered onto its rest frame, so nothing moves when the lamp goes down (reference/act3-seance/handback.md, operation 3). Once the séance ends the lamp comes up, and the group goes in the lit sheet.

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest, in the dark · 1 a breath (derived) · 2 the séance turns: the bald man's head jerked up, mouth open, and Frame's writing hand brought down onto the notebook. Played as a break, and acted when Frame writes in SEA_E1 (doc 95 row 113).

leaves.note: Doc 111, LEAVING THE TABLE: 'The lamp comes up. Thad stays where he is until the last pair of boots has gone.' The séance's end lands after its lines, and the town goes.
